title: Subtracting fractions across numerators and denominators
statement: Fractions are subtracted by subtracting the numerators and subtracting the denominators.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: subtract two fractions with unlike denominators
evidence_patterns.signature: difference numerator = a - c and difference denominator = b - d for a/b - c/d

evidence_patterns.item_shape: subtract two fractions with like denominators
evidence_patterns.signature: subtracts denominators to get zero and cannot finish, or writes the numerator difference over 0

discriminators.vs_slip: Like-denominator items are diagnostic: the bug produces a zero denominator and the learner stalls. A slip does not.

vs.math.frac.add-across: Same mechanism for the other operation. Most learners with one have the other; test both.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 5.NF.A.1: add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators

resolved_by.label: CCSS 5.NF.A.1: add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
